comfort.scope: Explicit scene/camera/prop and held-state fixtures verify perceptual portrait acceptance, observation grace and collision-safe near-size assistance. The portrait faces deliberately differ from canonical size and viewer position. The Cathedral fixture uses real placement support, Rigidbody simulation, opening morph and the actual safety probe. This is focused integration QA, not autonomous puzzle solving or input-only carrying; GalleryMuseumMechanicsValidation separately checks real interaction, controller stairs and the Library handoff.

integration.scope: Explicit enlarged painting/panel solution fixtures are searched and checked with real placement geometry, capsule queries and the game's FootSafe predicate, then traversed with the actual CharacterController and exposure rules. Portrait negatives use labelled mathematical pose fixtures. The positive portrait sequence restores all three original pieces and uses camera pickup, CharacterController carry, shared perspective resize, Drop and PhysX only, followed by actual one-second observation. Cathedral pickup, carry, resize and Drop use public input to reach the helpful near-size threshold; the game then performs its disclosed safe size assistance. Player-only pickup and ground-approach entry fixtures are disclosed; the final controller walk begins on clear floor with a disclosed off-centre offset, climbs the actual sculpture staircase and crosses the aperture before the real Library scene transition. This is focused integration QA, not an autonomous full puzzle playthrough.

visual.scope: Explicit small/home and enlarged/scaled exhibit and camera pose fixtures. Actual 1600x900 player-camera rendering includes the existing post-processing stack. RenderTexture statistics and left/right eye movement verify a live, non-flat view-dependent library. A temporary magenta witness behind the aperture is visible when the portal surface is disabled and hidden when enabled; it is removed before final screenshots. This is visual/integration QA, not a claim of player-driven puzzle solving or traversal.
